authorized_by: owner rulings 2026-08-14 (PM), issued in response to the vocabulary census: (1) delisted leaves the economic scalar map; (2) inert means recognized + auditable + identity-preserving but excluded from economic consumption and from the economic conflict guard; (3) the four newly observed labels are KNOWN_UNADJUDICATED and must not be aliased; (4) refusal scope is the UNIT, not the run, except for global data-integrity failure; (5) the no-composition rule stands, at unit scope.
boundary: Zero-data. NO sealed access was used or required. No code was changed to produce this record. The census it rests on read the DEVELOPMENT partition only, hard-bounded.

channel_1_economic_scalar.feeds: ExecutionFacts.corporate_action_kind, and through it the _classify() STOP_CORPORATE_ACTION branch
channel_1_economic_scalar.uniqueness_guard: applies to THIS CHANNEL ONLY. Two differing economically adjudicated kinds on one relevant session are a composition the frozen model does not define, and refuse.

channel_2_terminal_delisting.does_not: derive a delisting return, invent a price, or participate in the channel-1 uniqueness guard.
channel_2_terminal_delisting.temporal_rule: action_date <= session(t+1). AT OR BEFORE, per dataset.py:303 'ad <= d'. NOT exact equality with t+1. UNCHANGED from v1.0.

channel_3_identity_audit_metadata.note: This channel is why 'inert' is now coherent. An inert kind stays VISIBLE in the audit metadata while having no economic effect and creating no economic conflict. The v1.0 formulation ('no economic effect but still causes economic conflict') was internally contradictory, which the census made concrete: spinoff+spinoffdividend on 69 development sessions.

frozen_channel_model.statement: Three independent channels. A kind occupies AT MOST ONE consuming channel. Double-consumption is prohibited - the principle Matrix A already applied to the identity event now applies generally.

RUN_REFUSE: schema corruption or a registered column absent
structural-manifest / P9 commitment mismatch, including date bounds and row counts
mutation of a governed input, or of the bound decision record
inability to establish the bound dataset, roster, closure identity or contract identities
anchors table absent (a missing table must never silently disable the frozen earnings controls)
universe enumerates no units; crosswalk produces no lineage records
UNIT_REFUSE: unknown vocabulary encountered by the unit
known-unadjudicated kind encountered by the unit
two differing economically adjudicated kinds on the unit's relevant session (no-composition, OWNER RULING 5)
frozen_refusal_scope.relevance_definition_frozen: A unit is (symbol, decision session t, side). An ACTIONS row is RELEVANT to that unit when its ticker is the unit's symbol AND its session is the unit's t+1 - the same key _facts() already reads - except for channel 2, whose frozen predicate is at-or-before session(t+1) for that symbol. A row that is relevant to no unit has NO effect on the run. This single sentence removes the ('BKR','2019-10-20') failure mode: whether BKR was even a universe member was never established, and under this rule it does not matter unless it was.
frozen_refusal_scope.ruling: OWNER RULING 4, 2026-08-14 - the most important one. An unadjudicated action kind or an unresolved multi-action conflict stops the UNIT whose semantics cannot be established, while independent units continue. Whole-run refusal is reserved for genuinely GLOBAL integrity failures. This is still fail-closed; it puts the refusal at the scope of the uncertainty.
frozen_refusal_scope.ruling_5_no_composition: OWNER RULING 5: dividend+split and acquisitionof+dividend on one relevant session remain a refusal. The frozen model defines no composition semantics and none is to be invented - no ordering, no combined return. What changes is ONLY that the refusal is the unit's, not the run's.

1_ECONOMICALLY_ADJUDICATED.note: cash_only_acquisition, stock_and_cash_acquisition and merger are frozen edge-case SPECIFICATION labels and were not observed in the development feed. They stay adjudicated; an unobserved adjudicated label costs nothing. Their presence in this list is precisely why v1.0's roster looked complete while missing feed labels.

2_TERMINAL_DELISTING.ruling: OWNER RULING 1, 2026-08-14: delisted LEAVES the economic scalar map. Once it has a dedicated channel it must not also participate in the economic uniqueness calculation, or acquisitionby+delisted remains a false composition conflict and the same event is consumed twice. Clears 77 development co-occurrences. _classify() already ranks DELISTING above CORPORATE_ACTION, so no outcome changes where both would have applied.

3_UPSTREAM_IDENTITY_LINEAGE.do_not: populate ExecutionFacts.identity_transition from these rows - that double-consumes one identity event and could turn AUTHORIZED continuity into an enrichment stop.

UNCHANGED from v1.0.

4_EXPLICITLY_INERT.note: bankruptcy and regulatorychange are research-layer labels (eligibility.py:170) that the development feed never emitted. They stay registered and inert.
4_EXPLICITLY_INERT.ruling: OWNER RULING 2, 2026-08-14: recognized + auditable + identity-preserving, but excluded from economic consumption AND from the economic conflict guard. 'Inert' cannot mean 'no economic effect but still causes economic conflict'.

5_KNOWN_UNADJUDICATED.channel: none - no invented economic scalar effect
5_KNOWN_UNADJUDICATED.refusal: UNIT_REFUSE when encountered by an evaluated unit
5_KNOWN_UNADJUDICATED.ruling: OWNER RULING 3, 2026-08-14: these are observed in the feed and unadjudicated in Phase 3B. They are NOT to be silently aliased. Specifically: do NOT infer spinoff == spinoffdividend, and do NOT infer bankruptcyliquidation == bankruptcy, merely because the names are similar. Until separately adjudicated they have no invented economic effect; where one is relevant to an evaluated unit, that unit fails closed rather than pretending its semantics are known.

6_UNKNOWN_VOCABULARY.refusal: UNIT_REFUSE when encountered by an evaluated unit

1_the_frozen_refusal_taxonomy_cannot_be_.consequence: the bridge needs its own registered code namespace, owned by the Phase-3B layer.
1_the_frozen_refusal_taxonomy_cannot_be_.finding: spq1/refusals.py is a bound PRODUCER module (R-PROD, byte-identical to Phase 2B 1cc98f5) and SignalRefusal asserts membership in REFUSAL_CODES. Unit-scope bridge refusals therefore CANNOT be expressed as SignalRefusal codes without breaking the producer identity binding.
1_the_frozen_refusal_taxonomy_cannot_be_.status: PROPOSED. These names are the one place this record goes beyond what the rulings spelled out, and they are flagged rather than frozen so they can be vetoed.

2_unit_refusals_are_currently_never_publ.finding: ProducerCandidateSource.refusals is collected (candidates.py:146,177) and is asserted only in tests. No deliverable publishes it; runner.py, census.py and publish.py never read it.
2_unit_refusals_are_currently_never_publ.requirement: publish a per-code, per-reason refusal census as a deliverable, reconciled against records_examined + refusals == units, which the existing tests already assert. A MATERIALITY threshold above which unit refusals are a governance finding rather than a silent pass is REQUIRED and is NOT set here - it is an owner decision.
2_unit_refusals_are_currently_never_publ.why_it_is_now_load_bearing: under unit-scope refusal this list becomes the primary evidence surface. A systematically unadjudicated kind could refuse a large share of units while the run still reports PASS with a quietly reduced population - trading a visible abort for an invisible one. That is a worse failure than the one being fixed.

implementation_constraints_discovered.3_corporate_actions_must_become_unit_sco: the map is currently constructed eagerly over the ENTIRE actions table, so the conflict check fires before any unit is considered. Under the frozen relevance definition the classification and the uniqueness guard must be evaluated per unit at _facts() time, and the resulting refusal must be caught where SignalRefusal is caught today (candidates.py:176-178), which currently runs BEFORE _facts().

CIK-UNRESOLVED-IS-A-WHOLE-RUN-ABORT.incidence: UNMEASURED. Not censused here: it was not established whether the crosswalk is a validation-prefixed or reference-prefixed object, and the conservative reading is not to query it. The defect is provable from the code regardless of its rate.
CIK-UNRESOLVED-IS-A-WHOLE-RUN-ABORT.recommendation: adjudicate under the same OWNER RULING 4 principle. NOT assumed here - ruling 4 was issued about action-kind semantics, and extending it silently is exactly the kind of scope drift this record exists to prevent.
CIK-UNRESOLVED-IS-A-WHOLE-RUN-ABORT.statement: candidates.py:230 raises CandidateSourceRefused('no registered CIK for X') inside _produce(), but candidates() catches only SignalRefusal - so a PER-UNIT condition aborts the entire run. The same shape as the defect that spent opening 3, still armed.
CIK-UNRESOLVED-IS-A-WHOLE-RUN-ABORT.why_it_is_reachable: cik_by_symbol_from() deliberately leaves an ambiguous symbol OUT of by_symbol. Its own docstring states the intent: 'a unit whose symbol is ambiguous will fail to resolve a CIK and refuse, which is the governed outcome, and the caller can count how many securities that affected instead of wondering where they went.' The intent is per-unit; the implementation is per-run. Any universe symbol that is ambiguous in the crosswalk aborts the run.

purpose: Freeze the distinction the previous design conflated: recognized vocabulary, economic consumption, identity/audit visibility, and scope of refusal were treated as one axis. They are four. This record separates them so implementation can proceed from an adjudicated model rather than from field names.

the_conflation_that_caused_three_pre_res: corporate_actions() answered one question - 'what is the kind on this (ticker, session)?' - and that single answer was simultaneously the economic scalar, the published audit identity, the uniqueness-conflict subject, and the run's life-or-death condition. Any kind that was merely PRESENT could therefore abort a research run whose economics it had no bearing on. Separating the channels is the repair; extending the roster was not.
